title: Base Event
description: Canonical event schema for all CloudForge domain events.

eventId.description: Globally unique identifier for this event occurrence.

eventType.description: Event type in format Domain.Action. Examples: User.Created, Task.Updated

source.description: Name of the service/studio that emitted the event.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the event occurred.

correlationId.description: ID to correlate related events across services.

causationId.description: ID of the event that caused this event (if applicable).

payload.description: Event-specific payload. Must extend base entity schema where applicable.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the schema used for this event.
